facts.title: NEL evolutions
facts.text: NEL Nagi and NEL Isagi questlines and NEL wheel introduced. Their reworks were still upcoming in this announcement.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Mini update and private server settings
history.text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: Nagi and NEL Nagi rework
history.text: Base Nagi awakening and NEL Nagi kit reworked, including Skull Trap to Breakdance Shot.

history.title: Nagi and Isagi evolution
history.text: NEL questlines and wheel introduced; Generational rarity removed, with Generational styles moved to World Class at the time.

history.title: NEL Nagi and Singularity
history.text: NEL Nagi World Class at release, with volley and ball-control passives. Singularity flow introduced and other styles adjusted.

history.title: Reo and Nagi update
history.text: Reo style and flow, Nagi shooting ability and flow, Sae–Shidou chemistry and Isagi U20 goal added.

history.title: Shidou and Nagi update
history.text: Shidou style added, Nagi buffs and awakening ability announced.

history.title: Early gameplay patch
history.text: Direct Shot fixed, tackle speed increased and duration reduced; Nagi aerial tackle issue addressed.
